 in Osmolality
In general, alterations in osmolality occur when there is a shift 
of water without a corresponding shift in solute (electrolytes). 
Th is most commonly involves changes in the concentration of 
sodium in the ECF or hyperglycemia associated with uncon-
trolled diabetes mellitus.
A change in osmolality within the ECF directly inﬂ uences os-
molality of the ICF. Th is would also be consistent in the oppo-
site situation where change in the osmolality in the ICF directly 
inﬂ uences the osmolality of the ECF.
